verifications.claim: At a narrow approximately 320px viewport, all four audit rows, headings, counts, variances, and action buttons remain readable and reachable.
verifications.evidence: The trace did not record setting a 320px viewport or reloading the page; the only visibility observation refers to the available viewport in step 2.

verifications.claim: Increasing Cable 2m once changes its count from the system value 18 to 19 and its variance to +1, without changing the other rows.
verifications.evidence: Step 6 observed Cable 2m change from 18 to 19 with variance +1, while the other three rows remained at their system values.

verifications.claim: Submitting an audit displays an 'Audit submitted' confirmation modal with recording confirmation text.
verifications.evidence: Step 7 observed that clicking Submit audit immediately displayed a modal over a dimmed page with the 'Audit submitted' heading and recording/queued confirmation message.

verifications.claim: The submitted-audit modal can be dismissed with Escape and Close, while preserving Cable 2m's changed count.
verifications.evidence: After Escape, step 8 observed no modal or dimmed overlay and Cable 2m still at 19/+1; after Close, step 11 observed the dialog absent with Cable 2m still 19/+1.

verifications.claim: Clicking outside the submitted-audit modal dismisses it.
verifications.evidence: Step 9 clicked the backdrop outside the dialog, but step 10 observed that the modal remained visible with its heading and Close button.

verifications.claim: Clicking Washer 11mm's plus stepper twice produces count 62 and variance +2 while other rows remain unchanged.
verifications.evidence: The Washer-targeted interactions were unreliable: steps 12-17 repeatedly changed Hex bolt M4 while Washer remained 60/—, so the intended Washer control was not successfully exercised and needs a reliable repeat.

findingTexts: Clicking the dimmed backdrop outside the open 'Audit submitted' modal did not dismiss it; the dialog and overlay remained visible after a fresh re-check.

3. Increase Cable 2m once and note its counted value and variance. Then Click Submit audit. — expect: A visible modal must appear with the Audit submitted heading and recording confirmation.
